title: Production comedy script
script:
I built OpenClaw as a lobster side-project. Warelay, Clawdbot, Moltbot. Rebrands aren't chaos. They're a trust workshop.
Your assistant, on your devices. Any OS. Any platform. Setup is an escape room. Less technical users are having a wonderful time finding the door.
Three hundred and eighty-seven thousand stars. Thirty public contributors. Celebrity crustacean. Quiet kitchen.
It reads messages, files, and a shell. Bring rate limits. I call that intimacy.
